map.保留 20% 电量应对逆风、低温衰减与突发机动，低温下安全系数应再放大: Keep 20% charge to handle headwind, low-temperature capacity loss and sudden manoeuvres; at low temperatures the safety factor should be larger still
map.大负载、逆风、低温都会抬高工作电流、缩短航程: Heavy payload, headwind and low temperatures all raise the working current and shorten the range

map.安时 Ah=容量 mAh÷1000；瓦时 Wh=Ah×标称电压；满电时间=Ah÷: Ampere-hours Ah = capacity mAh / 1000; watt-hours Wh = Ah x nominal voltage; full-charge time = Ah / working current (h); safe time = full-charge time x 0.8; full-charge range = full-charge time x flight speed; safe range = safe time x flight speed. Low temperatures and payload raise the current and shrink the range.
